lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Teatro Kalinaw Drama Club… 'UNLEASH YOUR SOUL'… Requires a three-minute emotional monologue…

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Nope. Absolutely not. I can barely recite during class recitation without my voice cracking.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I don't have enough tears for this club. Hard pass.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Why would I join a club where people argue for fun?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: My anxiety argues with me enough already. Next.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: YES-O… Save the Earth… 6:00 AM call time… bring shovels…

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Save the Earth? Yes. Wake up at 6 AM to dig holes in this heat?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: No. I love nature, but I love not sweating through my uniform more.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: The Paragon… School Publication… Air-conditioned office… needs writers and encoders…

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Wait. Aircon? And all I have to do is…

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Sit and type? No shouting? No running?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: This looks like the path of least resistance.
